notes.title: Update 0.53.2 — Housing + Major Optimization Patch
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45311870/b647691d99161ef149ad118707b6f880461c5d42.jpg[/img]

🔧 Systems & Logic
We’ve overhauled the core movement and priority algorithms. Shoppers now glide around obstacles more smoothly, get stuck in aisles far less often, and reach the checkouts more reliably.

We also refined the shopper behavior model.
Agents now weigh nearby items and queue lengths before picking a shelf, so their choices look more natural and predictable—no “overthinking,” just fewer random face-plants into walls.

Fixed a bug that prevented stores from earning a rating higher than 4.2 stars.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45311870/4b006cce3fa975f1ca2167231c1a042838bfefa6.png[/img]
🏠 Housing & Sleep
Home ownership is finally here! Choose from 3 houses and 10 apartments—each fully furnishable with our décor catalog (see below). Important: you can no longer crash on the office couch or “skip” the night on your tablet, so grab a bed for your new place!

🎨 Décor
The catalog now features 50+ new items—posters, sideboards, lamps, home furniture, and more. Mix and match to create the perfect look for your apartment or store.

🧠 Interface & UX
The main menu is alive and kicking: hover animations, silky tab transitions, and UI elements that scale perfectly even on ultra-wide monitors.

The changelog is now optional—hide it with one click if you’d rather dive straight into the game.

🎮 Widgets & Menus

Full main-menu redesign: bigger fonts, higher-contrast buttons, and faster response times thanks to cached fonts and icons. Even lightning-fast pause-menu hops stay hitch-free.

The in-game tablet got a fresh coat of paint.

Overlay tweaks: balance, date, and time stay visible only as long as you need. Transparency and font size auto-adjust to scene lighting, so numbers remain legible in bright spots.

Widgets and buttons tightened up—more info in less space.

📋 Quests
Quest system revamped—cleaner displays and more reliable completion logic.

🚀 Optimization & Performance
We dug deep into those pesky stutters to lighten your system’s load.

Rendering. The engine now predicts which objects will soon leave the frame and disables them a bit earlier, cutting draw calls by roughly 25 % in dense areas. LOD cascades were rebuilt so distant models slim down gradually—with no noticeable pops.

Textures. Re-packed atlases using BC7 cut disk size by about a third. Scenes now free up 250–400 MB of VRAM on average while keeping critical details (UI, fine text) razor-sharp.

Asynchronous loading. Heavy actors initialize in background threads, and meshes/materials stream in when needed. Even on an HDD, moving between zones no longer drags FPS into the mud; SSD users will hear only a gentle sigh from their fans.

NPC logic. The shopper scheduler now uses separate worker threads: one plots paths, one watches queues, another sets priorities. That shaved 2–4 ms off each frame in crowded scenes and virtually eliminated micro-spikes.

Memory management. We plugged small leaks in UI overlays and optimized the material pool, trimming ~200 MB off peak RAM use.

In short: the game breathes easier, micro-stutters are nearly gone, and your rig—no matter its horsepower—should feel noticeably smoother. Spot an FPS dip? Hit the new Join Discord button in Settings and let Support know; we’ll jump on it!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45311870/f03f8d6beca58a82ce61e5c1518603b76903e542.png[/img]
🖥️ Safe‑Mode Launch Options
If your screen ever turns into a modern abstract painting after changing resolution, don’t panic! You can now launch the game in DX11 or DX12 Safe Mode at 1920 × 1080. It’s a quick bailout while we keep ironing out window‑mode and resolution switching quirks.

🚀 Performance Impact
This optimization patch delivers a 1.5 × – 2 × FPS uplift. If you previously saw 150 FPS, expect something in the 225–300 FPS range—hardware-dependent, of course. We verified these gains on 15-plus test rigs covering a wide spread of configurations.

A few setups still act up: some start with solid FPS that gradually tapers off, while others begin low and then ramp up dramatically. We’re actively chasing down both quirks—thanks for your patience while we iron them out!

notes.title: Update: 0.52 — Growing and Improving!
notes.content:
Greetings, Managers! We've done a massive overhaul of the game — both inside and outside your favorite shopping mall, things have become much nicer. Here's what's new:

🏢 Major Changes:
 - The main shopping mall building has been completely replaced — now it's more beautiful and modern.
 - There's more greenery on the streets: vegetation has been added to bring the city to life.
 - The warehouse has been redesigned: it's now more convenient, spacious, and brighter thanks to additional windows.

🛍 Outdoor Shops:
Shops have appeared outside! Among them:
 - Car dealership
 - Lighting store
 - Plant shop (added and in progress)
 - Bicycle shop
 - Furniture store
 - Music store

📱 Interface & System:
 - The main menu has been redesigned
 - Fonts have been replaced with more readable and modern ones
 - The background scene in the main menu has been updated
 - The lottery is now available on the tablet — try your luck!
 - You can now collect profit from outdoor shops at the bank.

🌍 Localization:
Two new languages have been added:
 - Portuguese
 - Turkish

🔊 Audio Updates:
 - Ambient sounds have been added — both inside and outside the mall.
 - Characters now produce footstep sounds.
 - Fixed a bug where the environment volume did not affect the cinema — now you can make it quieter.

🛠 Fixes & Improvements:
 - Paths have been added to houses — the city feels cozier!
 - Save system fix — works more reliably now.
 - Removing a shelf no longer leaves behind an empty box.
 - Fixed a bug where boxes would spawn uncontrollably.
 - Fixed a bug where customers could teleport to the cashier.
 - Fixed a bug allowing players to walk through warehouse walls.
 - Tax widget now displays amounts correctly.
 - Glass materials have been improved — looks more realistic.
 - Fixed a bug where the mall name wouldn't update after changing it.
 - Food court: removed an extra item and an empty slot.

 - Multiple bugs have been fixed:
   - With NPC customers
   - With NPC storekeepers
   - With NPC store workers
   - Numerous bugs in interface widgets

Thanks for your feedback and support! The update is live — jump into the game and enjoy the new atmosphere 🌿
Stay tuned — more exciting things are on the way!

notes.title: Patch Notes Early Access v0.44.3
notes.content:
Dear Friends!

The new major update for Grand MALL Simulator is finally here!
Here’s what’s included in this update:

Optimization
[list]
[*] Approximately 70% of the code has been rewritten as we’ve decided to transition to a new data structure. This was done to optimize performance and allow for future expansion of the game.
[*] The file system has been reworked to improve performance. This process will be rolled out gradually over 2–3 phases (patches).
[*] The old save system has been replaced with a new, more efficient one. We’ve worked hard to make the transition as smooth as possible: new saves will be created automatically, and existing ones will be preserved wherever possible.
[*] Pedestrian logic has been optimized, improving their interaction with the environment.
[*] FPS capping has been added to optimize GPU performance.
[/list]
Bug Fixes and Improvements
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where Store Managers didn’t take movement speed into account. Now, the "Action Speed" parameter affects both picking up boxes and stocking shelves.
[*] Fixed tax logic. Employee salaries are now included in the total tax bill. If taxes remain unpaid for 14 days, they will be automatically deducted from your account with a penalty. All tax data has been reset to ensure a smooth transition.
[*] Fixed bugs that prevented some Store Managers and customers from reaching the second floor.
[*] Adjusted shelf levels so players can place them immediately after unlocking.
[*] Fixed incorrect tax calculations when reloading the game (+1 day added to the tax period).
[*] Resolved issues related to the snowball’s improper functionality.
[*] Changed the delete button assignments for decor and trash to prevent accidental deletions.
[/list]
New Content
[list]
[*] Fresh decor has been added to make your mall even more stylish!
[*] New shelves have been introduced for grocery stores.
[*] Added a feature that automatically rotates shelves to face the player for easier placement.
[*] A new widget has been added to the YMD Bank tablet menu.
[/list]
Localization
We’re excited to announce that the game is now available in new languages!
[list]
[*] German 
[*] French 
[*] Spanish 
[*] Italian 
[/list]
Important Notes
[list]
[*] All your Store Managers and cashiers have temporarily left their positions! But don’t worry, you can easily rehire them — we’re sure you’ve earned enough money by now. 
[*] A tasty gift awaits you in your office as compensation for the changes. Don’t forget to claim it!
[/list]
This update is an important step forward, laying the foundation for exciting new features and content in the future.
We’re deeply grateful for your support and feedback. It’s thanks to you that we continue to grow and improve the game every day. 
P.S. Minor bugs may still appear, so don’t panic and let us know if you encounter any! 
Our next step will focus on improving optimization and introducing new content. 
Stay tuned!

Updated Store Manager Logic:
- The Store Manager no longer returns to the starting position after filling each shelf if they still have a box in hand. Instead, they move to the next shelf until their materials are depleted.
 - Among all shelves in the store, the Store Manager now prioritizes the one with the fewest items.

Improvements and Fixes:
 - A bed has been added to the office so players can easily find a place to skip the night.
 - Minor interface improvements to enhance user experience.
 - Our workers have patched up the holes on the 3rd floor that allowed snow to fall inside the building.
 - Customer Feedback Rebalancing: Adjusted the logic for customer evaluations of product pricing.
 - Review System Update: The maximum number of reviews for a store has been reduced from 50 to 20. The store's rating is now calculated based on these 20 reviews.

New Content:
Two new decorative objects have been added so you can further customize your shopping mall.

notes.title: Christmas Event: Part 1🎄
notes.content:
Update News for Grand Mall Simulator!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45311870/bf3f65a033829543160bdd6a5da641c923730eee.png[/img]

We’re excited to share the latest updates and fixes for the game, as well as introduce the first part of our Christmas event. Here’s what’s new:

Christmas Event: Part 1🎄
The holiday spirit has arrived at your mall! 
Here’s what to expect in the first phase of the event:
 - Snowfall Outdoors: It’s snowing outside! Watch as snowflakes fall but melt before touching the ground it’s not quite cold enough to stick.
 - Christmas Decorations Added: Find festive items in the "Decor" section! You can place Christmas decorations both inside your mall and outdoors.
 - Affordable Holiday Decor: Christmas decorations are much cheaper than regular ones, so players can easily add some holiday cheer. Items include:
[list]
[*] Christmas trees
[*] Snowmen
[*] Wrapped gifts
[*] Star-shaped lamps
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45311870/3c63036b2644fb452ad6f99bd2e5efec5ccda03a.png[/img]

Fixes and Improvements:
 - Shelf UI Issue Fixed: The shelf interface now works as intended.
 - Store Manager Bug Resolved: Store Manager no longer gets stuck and will perform their tasks properly.
 - Improved Store Manager Behavior: Store Managers will now prioritize taking boxes from the store first and then from the warehouse.
 - Box Handling on Dismissal: When dismissing a Store Manager, any box they were holding will now drop to the ground instead of disappearing with them.
 - Music Playback Fixed: The music will no longer stop playing after the first track.
 -Motion Blur Added: By request from some players, we’ve enabled motion blur. You can easily disable it in the Gameplay settings if preferred.
 - Increased Reward for Construction Help: Assisting with store construction now rewards $50 instead of $25.

If you encounter any issues or difficulties, we’re ready to assist you in real-time on our [url=https://discord.gg/45pVxcYRVf]Discord server[/url]. Don’t hesitate to reach out—we’re here to help!

Thank you for your continued support and feedback! We hope you enjoy this update and the festive atmosphere in your malls. 
Stay tuned for more exciting content coming soon! 🎅🎁
